integrity: The upper bound is derived from the one-parameter rational objective. An explicit rational rank-two projection matrix supplies a nonempty genericity witness: exact symbolic arithmetic verifies six simple critical roots, avoidance of the projection-model poles, avoidance of the algebraic cut locus, and noncriticality at infinity.
scientific_limitations: The result computes the Grassmann distance degree only for the ruling-line curve of the balanced rational normal scroll S(2,2). It does not classify Grassmann distance degrees of arbitrary rational normal scrolls, and it makes no reality claim for the six generic complex critical points.
title: Grassmann distance degree six for the ruling curve of \(S(2,2)\)
